name.value: Days Inn - Victoria On The Harbour

description.value: Days Inn Victoria on the Harbour is a four-storey harbourfront hotel situated steps from Victoria's Inner Harbour, Parliament Buildings, and waterfront cycling trails. The property offers a range of rooms including kitchenette suites alongside a full harbourfront restaurant and bar with garden patio seating. Complimentary on-site parking is available for guests, making it a convenient downtown base for cyclists arriving by vehicle or needing secure car storage during a tour.
